tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod cing bskul ba bzhugs so// na mo ma hā kā la ya/ phun tshogs 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam shing / /gang la ci 'dod re skong yid bzhin nor/ /dpal ldan bla ma mgon po dbyer med la/ /snying nas 'dud do byang chub bar du skyongs/ /pad dkar 'dzin pa'i thugs rje'i chu gter las/ /legs 'ongs skye dgu'i gnyen gcig khro bo'i gar/ /'di na myur mdzad ye shes mgon po zhes/ /bstan srung kun gyi dbang por gyur la 'dud/ /'phags yul shar lho'i dur khrod rab 'jigs tshal/ /tsan dan nags tshal mthug po'i rwa ba na/ /'jigs rung ma mo mkha' 'gro'i ded dpon po/ /bsil ba'i tshal skyong tsan dan mgon por 'dud/ /de tshe sa ra ha dang shwa ba ra/ /sgra gcan sbas pa gnyis med rdo rje sogs/ /paṇa grub kun gyi 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha chen por 'dud/ /grub chen khyung po mnyam med rmog cog pa/ /skyer sgang pa dang sangs rgyas gnyan ston sogs/ /bod yul mnyam med shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi srung ma chen por 'dud/ /khyad par phun tshogs nor 'dzin khyon yangs 'dir/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos dharma pradzñā la/ /mngon sum zhal ston bran bzhin bka' sgrub pa'i/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing chen por 'dud/ /khyod kyi rnam 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' klas kyang / /res 'ga' 'dzum zhal gangs ri'i phung po'am/ /sprin dkar gsar pa lta bur snying la babs/ /phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs e ma mtshar/ /la lar 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser 'od 'phro/ /ban+dhu'i mdangs can nyi zer bye ba'i gzi/ /margad lhun po'i mdog can khro 'dzum gyis/ /tshe dbang dpal 'byor kun stsol 'di ngo mtshar/ /sdig can dam nyams shan pa khyod kyi sku/ /dbyar dus sprin rum 'thibs pa'i mun pa'i mdog /chu gter rba klong 'khrug 'dra'i khro gnyer bsdus/

/dus mtha'i me dpung 'bar ba'i spyan dmar bzlog /hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug stong sgrogs pas sa chen g.yo/ /zhal dmar gnam sa'i bar du rab gdangs shing / /mche ba'i ser rkang ljags kyi glog dmar 'khyug /khrag rgyun 'khol ma'i lbu 'phreng phyogs bcur g.yo/ /stong gsum dam nyams 'byung po ma lus pa/ /skad cig nyid la hab kyis za ba snyam/ /de 'dra'i mi sdug srin zhal mthong ma thag /bstan dgra sde bcas ming gi lhag mar byed/ /khyod kyi bka' nyan yum mchog re ma ti/ /myur mgyogs rlung ltar g.yo ba'i drel 'u'i steng / /'jigs rung srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'phrul can/ /'dod khams ma mo'i gtso mo de la 'dud/ /yaḥ drag po'i las sgrub zhing skyong gdug pa can/ /mgon po'i bka' nyan bstan dgra'i srog gi gshed/ /dom nag smyon pa zhon nas stong gsum skor/ /sde brgyad kun gyi gtso bo khyod la 'dud/ /dbang phyug sras po dzi na mi tra dang / /srog bdud gshin rje ṭak+ki rā dza dang / /bdud nag mgon po trag shad dus mtshan sogs/ /bka' nyan dregs pa 'khor bcas rnams la 'dud/ /rang bzhin stong nyid rnam pa mchod pa'i rdzas/ /byed las dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas kyi/ /dges pa bskyed byed phyi nang gsang ba yi/ /mchod sprin rab 'byams kun gyis khyod mchod do/ /khyad par dmar chen gtor ma ri ltar spungs/ /sman phud rak+ta'i tshogs ni mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /mthing nag dar gyi lhab lhub sprin ltar stibs/ /gsol lo mchod do myur mdzad mgon po'i tshogs/ /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i dam tshig dgongs/ /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi ngag ma bcag /sngon tshe dam tshig thugs dam bcas pa bzhin/ /da ni bcol ba'i 'phrin las dus la bab/ /rnam dag rgyal ba'i bstan pa khyod kyis skyongs/ /rnam dkar dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod/ /rnam 'dren bla ma'i sku tshe khyed kyis srings/ /rnam mang dge 'dun sde 'di khyod kyis srungs/

/khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing / /mthun rkyen phun tshogs nyer mkho ma lus pa/ /thams cad yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /khyad par chos min snang ba rab zhi zhing / /rim gnyis zab mo'i ting 'dzin dga' ston la/ /nam yang g.yo med rtse gcig gnas pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa 'grub par mdzod/ /mdor na deng nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /dpal ldan mgon po khyed dang mi 'bral zhing / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i re 'dod kun/ /thogs med myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces myur mdzad mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod cing bskul ba 'di/ ri gong mgon po rang byon gyi drung du rnal 'byor pa blo gsal gyis thogs med du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la bstod cing bskul ba/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
